fixes.find: Four symptoms qualify. A gas smell. Water pouring from the boiler or a relief valve discharging. A carbon monoxide alarm sounding. No heat at all in freezing weather. A gas odor means leaving the building and calling the utility first. The others mean switching the boiler off at its service switch, then closing the water feed if a leak is spreading.
fixes.replace: Four symptoms qualify: a gas smell, a carbon monoxide alarm sounding, water pouring from the boiler or a relief valve discharging, and no heat at all in freezing weather. A gas smell means leaving the building and calling the gas utility or 911 from outside. A carbon monoxide alarm means getting everyone outside and calling 911 from there, without stopping to switch equipment off. For water or a discharging relief valve, keep clear of hot water and wet electrical equipment, leave valves and the water feed alone, and call for service.
fixes.why: CRITICAL: CO alarm grouped with switching boiler off and closing water feed; evacuate and call 911 from outside first

fixes.find: Keep a working carbon monoxide alarm on every sleeping floor, as the Illinois Carbon Monoxide Alarm Detector Act requires near sleeping areas.
fixes.replace: Keep working carbon monoxide alarms near sleeping areas; the Illinois Carbon Monoxide Alarm Detector Act requires an operating alarm within 15 feet of each sleeping room in the dwellings it covers.
fixes.why: CRITICAL: invented 'every sleeping floor' law wording; use 430 ILCS 135/10 scope (within 15 feet of each sleeping room)

fixes.find: On a hot water loop a single cold radiator is almost always trapped air or a partly closed valve. Bleeding the radiator clears trapped air. On a steam system the usual causes are a dead air vent on that radiator or a failed thermostatic valve. A pitch problem that lets condensate pool in the pipe does the same.
fixes.replace: On a hot water loop, a single cold radiator can come from trapped air, a partly closed valve or a restricted branch. On a steam system, possible causes include a failed air vent on that radiator, a failed thermostatic valve, or a pitch problem that lets condensate pool in the pipe. Bleeding a radiator and handling hot valves or fittings is technician work.
fixes.why: MAJOR: 'almost always' trapped air; list possible causes by system type, bleeding and hot fittings are technician work

fixes.find: Annual boiler maintenance blows down the low water cutoff, checks the gauge glass and tests the relief valve. A steam boiler making wet steam is skimmed, and operating pressure is set low, where a steam system is designed to run. A hot water system instead gets the expansion tank charge, the circulator and the air separator checked.
fixes.replace: Depending on the equipment and manufacturer instructions, annual maintenance on a steam boiler can include testing the low water cutoff (blowing it down where it is a blow-down type), checking the gauge glass and testing the relief valve, with operating pressure checked against the system design. Skimming a boiler that makes wet steam is a corrective task once diagnosed, not an automatic annual step. A hot water system instead calls for checks of the expansion tank charge, the circulator and the air separator. The written scope should say which tasks apply.
fixes.why: MAJOR: fixed maintenance checklist (blowdown, skimming) stated as automatic; make conditional on equipment and written scope

fixes.find: On a steam boiler the low water cutoff is blown down and the gauge glass is read. On a hot water system the relief valve, expansion tank and circulator are inspected.
fixes.replace: On a steam boiler the low water cutoff and gauge glass may be checked, as the equipment allows. On a hot water system the relief valve, expansion tank and circulator may be inspected.
fixes.why: MAJOR (consistency with item 6): unregistered visit checklist stated as fixed company procedure

fixes.find: A repair that uses a part carried on the van is usually finished the same visit, while a special order control means a return trip.
fixes.replace: A repair that uses a part on hand may be finished the same visit, while a special order control means a return trip.

fixes.find: From September 15 to June 1 the general rule in the Chicago Municipal Code is at least 68 degrees from 8:30 a.m. to 10:30 p.m. The same rule sets 66 degrees from 10:30 p.m. to 8:30 a.m. where the landlord supplies the heat.
fixes.replace: The Chicago Municipal Code sets a heating season from September 15 to June 1. Where the landlord supplies the heat, the general rule is at least 68 degrees from 8:30 a.m. to 10:30 p.m. and at least 66 degrees overnight.
fixes.why: READ-01 minor: sentence over 30 words split
